text: After a nursing shift in Milwaukee, Ana wakes to find [a neighbour girl in the bedroom, and her husband dead and then risen|threat|the dead that rise]. She flees the chaotic neighbourhood and joins a police sergeant, a salesman and others in a shopping mall, where guards lock out the crowds of dead. Weeks pass with whiteboard messages to a man trapped in a gun store across the parking lot, but [every bite and scratch is a sentence|rules|it passes to others], and a [pregnant woman hides her wound|who_suffers|expectant parents].
